messages.subject: Linux installation without Python/Docker
parts:
Hello everyone,

In case someone is having trouble installing FIELDimageR on Debian/Ubuntu without Docker or Python dependencies, these steps worked for me.

First, install the following system dependencies (root needed):

sudo apt-get install libgit2-dev libssh2-1-dev libfftw3-dev xorg libx11-dev

Then install the following R package dependencies:

install.packages(c("devtools","sp","raster","rgdal","scales","xml2","git2r","usethis","fftwtools"))

And finally install FIELDimageR:

devtools::install_github("filipematias23/FIELDimageR")

System information:
OS: Ubuntu 20.04.1 LTS
R version: 3.6.3

Congratulations on your excellent work, Filipe!

Best,
Gabriel
